description: Institutional electricity sheet 2026: grid electricity for July 2026 only (HT/Industrial, Commercial and Temporary connections, kWh), transcribed from the source supplied and approved for import by the project owner on 2026-10-01. The connections are identified by the sheet's consumption columns (Industrial Consumption -> grid_ht_kwh, Commercial Consumption -> grid_commercial_kwh, Temp Consumption -> grid_temporary_kwh), which reproduce the governed Jan - Jun 2026 series exactly; the sheet's repeated Equipment labels are not used. The grid total and Scope 2 emissions are not source data: the backend sums the three meters and applies the governed GRID_ELECTRICITY factor. Jan - Jun 2026 are already governed and are not part of this source; August 2026 has not been approved for import.
